sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Krantz is one of the playable character in the Grand Quest. He was the captain of the Ninth Division of Demon Slayers, as well as the leader of the squad after Griff left to fight Shusui in Celgrad.

sections.title: History
sections.content:
Krantz was a soldier of humble origins from the Elgaia Federation, whose talent began to blossom rapidly under the tutelage of Summoners of Old. Grahdens stated that Krantz was a young man brimming with talents and that the Summoners of Old had high expectations of him. However, Krantz was infamous for his terrible relationship with machines. It was the Vice Commander of his squad who helped him with machines.

After the squad arrived in Ishgria, they were halted by Shusui. Griff then entrusted the position of the commander to Krantz while he challenged Shusui to a duel;Krantz and the rest fled the battle. Afterwards, they were ambushed by a demon beast. Rhoa then ordered Krantz and the rest to leave him alone, as he would take down the demon. Kafka then went back to Rhoa's side shortly after they escaped. With just three members left, including Krantz himself, they had to face Kalon. Krantz then asked Mirfah to run to somewhere safe, while he stayed behind with Libera. He met his demise in the battle against Kalon.

sections.title: Character
sections.content: Krantz is shown as a serious young man, who tends to overthink things as the exploration continues and the members of the squad decreased. He still has his cheerful side, though, as shown in the beginning of the Grand Quest, when he asked Mirfah to continue the exploration.
